Entity.name: Past due debt security
Entity.comment: Past due debt security is a debt security past due in accordance with Part 2.48 of Annex V to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 680/2014.
Entity.commentInRDBMS: Past due debt security is a debt security past due in accordance with Part 2.48 of Annex V to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 680/2014.

Attribute.name: Date past due
Attribute.comment: The date on which the asset became past due in accordance with Part 2.48 of Annex V to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 680/2014. This is the latest such date prior to the reporting reference date and it is to be reported if the instrument is past due on the reporting reference date.
